elements.label: Detective Credentials
elements.description: You need a license to be a cop?
elements.comment: The job will disappear if you leave the town. The license is used to spawn the job. Job works reasonably different from men in black positions, being more forgiving and more susceptible to bribery

elements.label: Inspector's Position
elements.description: I have a senior position in the capital's police force, although I have been seconded to the Suppression Bureau.

elements.label: Inspector of Police [Suspended]
elements.description: My absence has been noted. I've been suspended. [Plead your case soon, or lose your position forever.]
